title: sonchus nudicaulis
intro: Sonchus nudicaulis, commonly known as Yellow Salsify or Woolly Lettuce, is a perennial plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The health benefits of Sonchus nudicaulis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus nudicaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
